name: Heavy kick
notes: Re-derived from the re-timed clip (PR #41): frames_total 38, S/A/R 11/4/23. Foot is still at 66% reach at the cut: blend the retraction out over 6 ticks. Hitstun 27 and blockstun 24 give about +4 on hit and +1 on block (not in rules.md; the harness tunes them). Boxes in units (E1) read from clip stills; the second hurtbox is the extended limb. HEAD-HIGH kick (clip 215 High_Kick, foot at 129-144 cm). The designer asked for a mid kick; the preset library has no mid variant, so this kick hits high: it must be blocked standing and a crouching opponent can duck it (E6). FLAG for the designer. C8 target 12/4/22; clip gives 11/4/23 (clip wins, F2). Knockdown per C8.
